hypothesis: Geothermal faults are both mechanical (linear DEM slope-break) and hydrogeochemical (linear K/Th radiometric alteration edge) structures. Fusing the two independent lineaments as S = L × R (L = pct_rank(||grad det_elev_slope||) × coherence(det_elev) from Bands 12/19; R = pct_rank(||grad(K/Th)||) × coherence(K/Th) from GeoDAWN K/Th ratio; S_pct = pct_rank(S)) selects altered, mechanically active conduits while suppressing shoreline terraces (DEM-only) and lithologic contacts (radiometric-only). The H19-5 worm skeleton behind R0 missed such thin-alluvium, sinter-sealed geothermal faults with no potential-field contrast; expert LiDAR mappers trace their subtle scarp and radiometric halo instead. Placing 45% of budget on fused scarp-alteration ridges >3px off the worm skeleton tests that geothermal conduit channel.
mechanism: At fixed S=37,654, DTI rises when expected T gains outweigh denominator growth. Kept skeleton dots are chosen by exact marginal expected-DTI greedy (alpha 0.2 beta 0.8 R=3px) under w=0.30+0.70*S_pct on H19-5 support; coverage-redundant parent dots are donors. Far dots take the strongest remaining fused scarp-alteration lineaments first (descending S_raw, 2.8px spacing floor). Dose ladder f33 0.004453, f38 0.004413, f45 0.004324 shows monotone decline vs BREAKLINE f45 0.004861 on the catalogue holdout — the fused product does not concentrate per-pixel fault probability as strongly as the DEM-only detector on withheld catalogue truth. SGMC off-catalogue proxy 0.1157 vs R0 0.09606 (+20% vs BREAKLINE +31%) confirms some off-catalogue signal but insufficient to offset catalogue loss.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Silicified volcanic flow margins (rhyolite K-rich vs basalt K-poor) with coincident topographic steps, playa evaporite terraces where K/Th changes sharply across a compaction scarp, and road/berm construction corridors all produce co-located linear DEM + radiometric breaks without Quaternary surface rupture; Lahontan shoreline terraces that are also radiometrically anomalous via evaporite concentration remain a joint mimic.
